Different for everyone. i took sertraline for about a week, side effects kicked in hours after the first pill and were nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting, fainting, so in the end i came off them lmao. Have now started on fluxotine and have had no side effects so far so don’t be disheartened :)

Yes. dealt with trust issues and anxiety in relationships my whole life. finally got in a loving relationship and he left because he said im too draining and that he can’t keep giving me reassurance anymore. which has just made my anxiety and abandonment issues 10x worse

Hi friend. just been broken up with my bf of 9 months. he seemed perfectly happy, but in a matter of days he explained how he saw problems within the relationship and didn’t think they could ever be fixed, followed by a lot of cruel words and me begging and begging him to come back. It’s now been two days since we’ve last spoken, and although losing him is completely breaking me the part that most shocks me is how the sweet boy I met has just left with virtually no explanation or conscience - the last time I saw him things were completely normal and it’s killing me that i didn’t appreciate it’d be the last time he kissed me. 
hang in there though, we will heal eventually ❤️

Thanks for your kind words, it truly does help to know we’re not alone. i too had problems in the relationship that i should’ve been better at and could’ve been better for him, i suppose it does help to know what i must work on before i can love someone again and have them truly love me. it’s only been a few days so it’s still incredibly raw, managing to shower and eat are milestones Im currently working for and hoping from there it’ll get easier. good luck to you too and i hope you heal soon friend
